title: Motorhome & RV Calendar 24 Doors – Retro Buses and Camping Gear
seo_title: Motorhome & RV Calendar 24 Doors – Advent Calendar
seo_description: Advent calendar with 24 doors. Behind almost every door waits a small miniature retro bus – a couple of doors offer camping gear instead.
descriptionHtml:
The advent calendar counts down to Christmas, not to the next trip

The motorhome or caravan has been in storage since autumn, and December feels like the month furthest from the next trip. A chocolate calendar tastes the same for everyone – it says nothing about the travel fever that is already waiting for spring.

24 numbered doors, a retro bus behind almost every one

Behind each of the 24 numbered doors waits a small miniature retro bus, in different colors and patterns – some flower-painted, others blue, green or two-tone. A couple of doors hide camping gear instead, like a camping chair and a small table. The box is orange, printed with "CAMPER ADVENT CALENDAR – HOLIDAY ROAD TRIP" and a flower-painted retro bus in hippie style.

Features

  • A small retro bus waits behind almost every door – 24 numbered doors count down to Christmas Eve
  • The color varies from door to door – buses in flower-painted, blue, green and two-tone patterns
  • You can see what the calendar is made for before you even open it – orange box printed with "CAMPER ADVENT CALENDAR – HOLIDAY ROAD TRIP"
  • A couple of doors offer camping gear instead – a camping chair and a small table among the buses.
